notes.title: Firestorm Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29001544/dfc1844d3098084cadac107ee554f7cbb4b29a09.jpg[/img]

Hello Rebels!

We are back and ready to deliver the largest War Tech Fighters update since it’s full launch! 

[B]New Game Plus[/B]

New Game Plus will be unlocked once you have finished the basic campaign, this gives you a ton replayability and more of the fast-paced, space action you have come to expect. New Game Plus will allow you to replay the campaign keeping your upgrades to your War tech, but this time it will not be so easy, the enemies will be much tougher so you will need all the firepower you can muster to take on and defeat this new threat. 

[B]New weapons and components[/B]

We have also added a whole bunch of new exciting weapons and components to customise your War Tech in the New Game Plus mode. 

[*]Black Mantis unique set available in NG+ mode (unlocked for EA users)
[*]Quantum Unicorn sword available in NG+ mode
[*]Tsunami Max Arms components available in NG+ mode
[*]Armageddon Max Arms components available in NG+ mode
[*]Stronghold Max Torso components available in NG+ mode
[*]Juggernaut Max Torso components available in NG+ mode
[*]New “Firestorm” components with added missile launchers

[B]Gameplay and performance[/B]

[*]Switched to a newer version of the engine that enhances performance and increases optimisation
[*]New research “Enhanced scanner” to improve resources collecting
[*]Re-tuning of the mission rewards
[*]Faster and more responsive terminal hacking
[*]Level cap raised to 80
[*]3 new Achievements
[*]Special Project “War Machine” with a custom set of components
[*]Spanish language added 

[B]user interface and Graphics[/B]

[*]Increased graphics fidelity with the latest game engine version
[*]Improved VFX and particle systems
[*]New UI for the War Tech components with a tree-like structure

We hope you enjoy the Firestorm update with all the exciting new content and stunning visual updates. 

- Drakkar Dev

notes.title: Full release build notes
notes.content:
Hello Defenders of Hebos,

War Tech Fighters is no longer an Early Access but a complete and full release. From everyone at Drakkar Dev, THANK YOU so very much for helping get to this point!

For everyone who supported us through the Early Access period, we offered you a special purchase price of $14.99. With the game now feature complete, we will be increasing the SRP on 8 August 2018 to $19.99. If you are reading this and have not yet bought the game, now would be a GREAT time to do so, especially with the current 50% launch discount (ending August 1 2018).

So, exactly what has been added to the game since we launched on to Early Access back in August 2017?

[h1]Core updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Story Missions: Increased from 12 (5-6 hours) to 33 (15-20 hours)
[*]Robot Components: 110 components have been added or changed increasing the number of available components from 70 to over 180
[*]Research & Development: 86 projects have been added giving 160 projects in total
[/list]

[h1]Unique War Tech Sets:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Since launch, 3 unique War Tech's have been added to the game
[*]The Mantis
[*]The Fury
[*]The Reaper
[*]Each unique war Tech comes with their own design and weapon configurations. These can only be unlocked by finding and developing their respective special projects.
[/list]

[h1]Visuals:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Extended Field of View
[*]Improved lighting
[*]Doubled textures resolution
[*]Robot components restyle
[*]Enhanced Post Processing FX
[*]Background graphics restyle
[*]Increased models details
[*]Enhanced particles FX
[/list]

[h1]Main Menu:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the Database Deck
[*]Added more colors for War Tech customization
[/list]

[h1]Special Projects:[/h1]
There are now 13 projects to collect, scattered across the missions.that can be used to unlock:
Unique Sets
[list]
[*]Unique Sets
[*]Special Components
[*]Swords and Shields
[*]Researches
[/list]

[h1]Performance enhancement:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Huge performance boost especially in crowded situations
[*]DX11 optimizations
[/list]

[h1]Swords & Shields:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added 24 swords and 15 shields for a total of 38 swords and 21 shields.
[*]New perks system has been implemented.
[/list]

[h1]Challenges:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased from 10 to 23
[/list]

[h1]Survival Arenas:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased from 1 arena to 3 from Rookie to Hero.
[/list]

[h1]Achievements:[/h1]
[list]
[*]22 new Steam achievements added, increasing the total to 42
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay:[/h1]

The following additional new gameplay features have also been added since launching on Early Access:
[list]
[*]Momentum-based movement
[*]Alternate Missile Launch mode
[*]Beams/Mirrors gameplay
[*]Quantum Wave
[*]Supernova Rays
[*]Warhead missiles
[*]Redesigned battle UI
[*]3D radar map
[*]10 new enemies with custom mechanics and executions
[*]Loads of gameplay tuning as suggested by the Steam community
[/list]

As you can see, War Tech Fighters is now a bigger and better game than when it originally launched on to Early Access and we know you will enjoy the final, complete version.

All our thanks

Drakkar Dev

notes.title: Prologue Patch Update
notes.content:
Hello defenders of Hebos!

A new patch update again!

This time:

PROLOGUE PATCH

- Selecting "new game" now starts a short "prologue" mission that serves as an introduction to the story and a "test drive" to new players making them feel the power of using an already developed War Tech before starting from scratch with the first actual mission.
The prologue can be skipped (from the pause menu) as it's not mandatory.

- New icons on the War Tech Components list now show if a component belongs to the "slow/tough" or "fast/energy" branch of development. The icons also change their color highlighting all the components of the same branch of the selected one.

- Dependancies of the War Tech components have been revised and now it's a lot easier switching from slow/tough to fast/energy ones or vice versa.

- A new revised logo for War Tech Fighters!

- Going Up/Down with a game controller can now be performed with Y and A buttons as well.

- The english texts of the Database have been revised.

- Many fixes for the issues reported by the Steam community.

notes.title: Enhanced Visuals Patch
notes.content:

a new patch is here!

- New coloring criteria when applying liveries on the War Techs: Greater visual variety.

- Restyle of many War Tech components, especially the ones at the very beginning of the game: No more skinny robots during the first missions.

- Enhanced look for any glowing/incandescent object: Swords, shields and guns look a lot better now.

- Destruction/explosion of smaller ships has been visually enhanced.

- Better lighting setup for many environments.

- New Ambient Occlusion HBAO post process FX.

- Added some new items in the Database.

- Many fixes and tweaks as suggested by the Steam community.

Thanks to all of you for your bug reporting and feedbacks!

notes.title: Database Update Patch
notes.content:
Hello Rebels of Hebos!

New patch/content update here!

[b]New Feature:[/b] The Database.
Do you want to know more about Nathan, the other characters, the Hebos' ships and the enemies you've encountered? A new hangar deck is waiting for you with a collection of all the knowledge, enemy ships and wartechs you meet during the game.
This deck is going to be updated and expanded in the next patches: if you have requests or ideas about topics you'd like to have in the database, just write in the feedback section.

[b]Technologies[/b] like Laser, Magnetic and Anti-Matter are now dependant from special projects.
Don't be scared thou, they're VERY easy to find and they require just one piece to be completed.
Of course, those who have already developed them will continue to have them unlocked.

There are also a number of fixes as suggested by you in the discussions forum. Thanks for your feedbacks!

notes.title: Supernova Update
notes.content:
Hello rebels of Hebos!

A new big update is here!
Lot of new contents, new missions and, of course, bigger and more powerful weapons to grind our enemies with.

[b]This is the last big update for War Tech Fighters...before it leaves Early Access![/b]

Of course there will be other patches/updates along the way and, even when the game is fully released, it will be regularly updated/fixed the same way we always did.
We're working very hard and very fast to give you all the game contents together with satisfying your requests (the ones that are feasible) in the shortest amount of time.

As usual, if you find something not working properly, bugs or other things you want to share with us, please [b]USE THE BETA TESTING FORUM[/b].
Please, [b]DO NOT USE[/b] this post (or the General Discussions) to report bugs.

Thanks to you all for your support.

Here's a list of the new update content:

[b]SUPERNOVA UPDATE[/b]
[b]New Contents:[/b]
5 new story missions.
4 new challenges.
A new Survival Arena “Ice Cold”, with X10 points multiplier, for really hardcore War Tech pilots.
[b]New Unique Set: [/b]“The Reaper” (unlocked for EA users)
[b]New Special Project and WarTech Set:[/b] 
	Supernova, featuring a powerful new kind of weapon.
    2 heads
    2 torsos
    2 arms
    2 legs
[b]New Swords:[/b]
Chimaera
Wrath
[b]New Shields:[/b]
Vortex
Spectre
[b]New WarTech components:[/b]
    17 Heads
    16 Torsos
    7 Arms
    15 Legs
[b]8 new Research Projects
6 new achievements[/b]

[b]Tuning/Changes:[/b]
- All survival maps now give rewards every 3 waves (instead of 5)
- Materials reward from missions has been significantly increased allowing you more freedom when upgrading your War Tech.
- Every new game now starts with 500 materials instead of 100.
- Simulator Mission Replays now show the missions resume.
- Many tutorials have been enhanced with more accurate informations.
- All the story dialogs have been reviewed/checked (English version).
- Special War Tech components now show a description of their peculiarities.
- Tooltips have been added to many menu items to better describe their meaning (when using the mouse).
- Missiles precision has been improved.
- Gfx: new HBAO with color bleeding (just set Ambient Occlusion to max).
- Customization Colors has been re-ordered by hue.
- Dialog texts can now be shown all at once with a button press.
- Materials Bonus collecting range has been extended.
- Barracuda ships can now be targeted by missiles.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Boost Mode trails now smoothly fade without clipping
- Fixed a camera clip glitch in low orbit missions
- Fixed a bug usually occurring during close combat, especially with the Challenge: Crusader III

notes.title: Quantum Update - Patch Notes
notes.content:
We’re pleased to release the first content update for [b]War Tech Fighters[/b] today! The [b]Quantum Update[/b] adds a huge amount of new stuff for War Tech Fighters. If you purchase the game during Early Access, you also get access to [b]The Mantis[/b] - an all new, unique War Tech. Read more about that below...

Here’s what’s included in this update - 
[list]
[*][b]Five New Story Missions[/b]. Continue the journey of Nathan Romanis and his comrades as they encounter new danger and face powerful enemies. 
[*][b]35 New War Tech Components[/b]. Each War Tech can be upgraded with more powerful parts and weaponry.
[*][b]New Unique War Tech - The Mantis (EXCLUSIVE for Early Access Owners)[/b]. The Quantum Update introduces the concept of Unique War Techs - one of a kind legendary War Techs, complete with their own custom visuals, bonuses and exotic weaponry.
[*][b]Perks System[/b]. Swords and Shields now come with perks - Critical Hits, Energy Drain, and more.
[*][b]Three New Swords[/b]. Harpy, Manticore and Unicorn.
[*][b]Four New Shields[/b]. Tower, Star, Hexagon and Forcefield.
[*][b]New Enemies[/b]. Face off against new ships, armed with custom weapons, with new gameplay mechanics.
[*][b]Changed Missile Launch System[/b]. Missiles no longer launch automatically, allowing for more strategic strikes and better energy management. This change was made thanks to user feedback during Early Access.
[*][b]New Weapon[/b] - Quantum Wave. A devastatingly disruptive weapon for mass destruction, that can be used both for combat and in some puzzle solving sections.
[*][b]New Survival Arena[/b]. "Smoke and Flames" is the toughest survival arena yet, for the most daring players - with a x3 points multiplier for the Leaderboard score.
[*][b]Three New Achievements.[/b]
[*][b]Eight New Research Projects.[/b]
[*][b]Four New Challenges.[/b]
[/list]

Thanks to all the users who have played [b]War Tech Fighters[/b] so far and provided feedback. We hope you have enjoyed all the changes made to the game so since our launch in Early Access, and can’t wait to hear what you think about this update!

Prep your War Tech, pilot - It’s time to kill some Zatronians!

notes.title: Patch Update n.7
notes.content:
Hello rebels of Hebos!

A new juicy update is here!

- New alternative missile launch mode. It’s now possible to launch missiles distributing them among the targets. A new section of the weapons tutorial (in the simulator) is available to explain how this new feature works.

- Extended field of view. If gives a better perception of distances and speed. All the environments look better and there’s a better perception of the enemies around you. Some GUI elements have been changed accordingly.

- Re-tuned some distances for executions, engaging WT, connecting to terminals and analysis.

- Extended range of navigation “pitch”. The War Techs can now pitch vertically (up and down) a lot more giving more freedom while navigating and aiming to targets.

- Revised texts (part I) for dialogs thanks to Vyar for his good work on them.

- “Hephaestus Anvil” fixed duplicated allies names.

- Re-tuned energy pool values. Now War Techs have (generally) more energy especially further in the game.

- Research project “Missile Friction Reduction” now has steps of 5-10-20% instead of 2-5-10 and costs fewer materials.

- Changed the Low Energy sound to be less annoying.

- Fixed some graphics glitches on the Minimap

notes.title: Patch Update n.4
notes.content:
Hello rebels of Hebos!

The fourth patch is here!

in this update:
- Fixed Vertical Sync option in Graphics Options.
- Added “Full Screen” to the Graphics options.
- New english terminology for Configuration menu, now named “Upgrades”
- Changed “Customize” into “Colors”
- Changed “Upgrade” into “Weaponry”
- New selection method in the Upgrades, Research and Simulator menus based on mouse-over (when using mouse+keyboard input)
- New icons layout in the Weaponry menu to better describe what bonus is influenced by a specific War Tech parts (head, arms, torso, legs, etc.)
- Some tutorials have been rewritten to be clearer.
- New guided tutorials on how upgrade/change War Tech part to obtain better performing weapons.
- Reworked some mission descriptions.
- The idle time to skip a cutscene/execution has been shortened.
- War Tech space navigation now has physical inertia. Inertia is proportional to the “weight” of the War Tech. Rhino class War Techs are the heaviest and have more inertia while Hawk class War Techs are the lightest.

We want to thank you all, players, for your precious feedback.
We're working hard to make this game better everyday
